XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars manufactured from 01/01/19 to 15/03/24 after restyling

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Communication module control unit (261)

  • Fault: Faults in the operation of the instrument panel display, such as sudden shutdowns, restarts, black screen, altered display, etc.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Communication module control unit software error (261)

• Action: Perform the software update of the communication module control unit (261)

  • Procedure: The software update must be performed using a USB stick and connecting a battery charger to the 12V battery terminals for the entire duration of the operation, in order to prevent the instrument panel from suddenly switching off during the update.

  • Notes: Using a diagnostic tool, verify that all related systems are functioning properly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
